tool_calls.arguments: {"focus":"Inspect the image for the throughput chart and the person standing in front. Do NOT identify the person. Provide: (1) non-identifying description of the person (position, clothing, approximate pose), (2) details of the throughput chart visible (axes labels, units, time range if readable, plotted series, legend), and (3) estimate of the peak value(s) on the chart with uncertainty and note any occlusion caused by the person that affects measurement."}
tool_calls.name: image_inspect
